messages: October 8 draft prepared after the 09:20 ET exclusive cutoff. The relative-strength stock universe was not captured; scanner stock and sector arrays remain empty and unranked.
Robinhood returned 320 timestamped extended-hours 1-minute bars each for SPY and QQQ from 04:00 through 09:19 ET. Their prior closes are official SIP closes dated October 7.
TradingView supplied timestamped ES/NQ futures, VIX, and Treasury-yield bars. Its provider notice warns data may be delayed 15+ minutes; actual observation times remain on each row.

TradingView returned 920 bars for ES and NQ through 09:19 ET. The YM range uses the last successfully calculated range through 09:18 ET. No verified RTY high/low pair was retained, so RTY remains null.

The 2Y yield remains null after TradingView requests failed with WebSocket handshake errors. The 5Y, 10Y, and 30Y values use timestamped bars; no daily-bar or percent-change estimates were substituted.
SPX is the October 7 cash-index close only; it does not trade premarket and was not substituted with ES.
Macro calendar checked against Trading Economics on October 8. Waller's 08:30 ET remarks and the 08:30 ET jobless-claims release had passed; only selected remaining events through Friday are listed.
